features.production: Reference pixels equal authoring units. Foreground masks/tonal shading are excluded. Card/inset-covered continuations are inferred; production scaling/placement is separate.

collie.production: Reference pixels equal authoring units. Foreground masks/tonal shading are excluded. Card/inset-covered continuations are inferred; production scaling/placement is separate.

registration: Identity crop coordinates; no global alignment optimization. Compare all visible contours, not a whole-image pixel score.
